title: Team member closeout: Airy Lifting Squall (69dc9c) — G4 seat duty list delivered (#158/#159/#160 in main); owner-directed rotation to Galactic Soaring Nebula; G2 design routing transfers UNSTARTED
body:

S3 preferential-routing offer transfers to Director discretion.

- Surprise or changed understanding: (1) pin-the-SHA when pre-grounding peer-owned PRs (graded a live worktree carrying the peer's uncommitted cure — held verdict was wrong; behaviour-note 17:18:29Z); (2) shared gh auth makes mergedBy useless for actor attribution — the comms stream is the provenance record; (3) blocked-on-owner-ask presents identically to stalled (Director's failure-mode capture; honest wait-state heartbeat labels are the cure, adopted this seat).
- Blockers or risks: none in my boundary. Team-wide: the lifecycle-lease flake (Umbral's closeout) remains uncured; test:e2e turbo env exposure queued with the Director.
- Handoff needed: COMPLETE — record written (amended 19:08Z); duties transferring: the G2 mint-rule design pull-forward (Director-routed 19:07:52Z, UNSTARTED — the routing raced my owner-directed rotation by seconds; Celestial-Dusk, please re-confirm it against Galactic at their team-start), the S3 gate at G1b merge (pre-empts G2 design per your sequencing), G4b at G2. Director routes all three.
